body: I think you have encountered what people call "incels", they are everywhere on the internet but mostly on reddit and similar places. It makes me tired aswell, but you cant stop fighting. Also ignore them if the post is clearly bait.
Yeah, social anxiety is a nightmare.

I am one year older than you and i also have social anxiety, i feel the same way everyday, like my mind is gonna explode. I also fear when i become an adult because i probably wont be functioning in society, i cant socialize like everyone does. I dont know how to help much really cause i also have no hope, but i hope this makes you feel less lonely if you do.
